pairs.description_left: Number density of helium-3 ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated as the local particle count per physical volume on the last closed magnetic flux surface and summed over charge states.
pairs.description_right: Number density of helium-4 ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated locally on the last closed magnetic flux surface and summed over all charge states.

pairs.description_left: Instantaneous equivalent-electron helium-3 source rate delivered to the plasma vessel by gas injection systems, where each injected helium-3 atom contributes two equivalent-electron counts.
pairs.description_right: Instantaneous equivalent-electron source rate of helium-4 delivered to the plasma vessel by gas injection, with each helium-4 atom contributing two equivalent-electron counts.

pairs.description_left: Number density of helium-3 ions at the divertor target is the local particle count per volume at the sheath entrance immediately upstream of the target-facing plasma boundary, summed over positive ionization states and excluding neutral helium-3 atoms.
pairs.description_right: Number density of helium-4 ions at the divertor target is the local particle count per volume at the sheath entrance, summed over singly and doubly ionized states and excluding neutral helium-4.

pairs.description_left: Particle number density of the helium-3 ion population evaluated at the magnetic axis is the local helium-3 ion count per physical volume at that location. It is summed over all helium-3 ionic charge states.
pairs.description_right: Particle number density of the helium-4 ion population evaluated at the magnetic axis is the local helium-4 ion count per physical volume at that location, summed over all helium-4 ionic charge states.

pairs.description_left: Angular-momentum source per unit volume generated by the Lorentz force, averaged over a magnetic flux surface and projected onto the toroidal direction for a specified particle population.
pairs.description_right: Angular-momentum source per unit volume generated by the Lorentz force, averaged over a magnetic flux surface for trapped particles.

pairs.description_left: Angular-momentum source per unit volume generated by the Lorentz force, averaged over a magnetic flux surface for counter-passing particles.
pairs.description_right: Angular-momentum source per unit volume generated by the Lorentz force, averaged over a magnetic flux surface and projected onto the toroidal direction for a specified particle population.

pairs.description_left: Fick's-law neutral internal-state energy diffusion coefficient multiplying the temperature gradient of neutral particles in one internal state in diffusive thermal-energy transport, serving as the direction-agnostic parent over its radial and poloidal component forms.
pairs.description_right: Fick's-law poloidal neutral internal-state energy diffusion coefficient multiplying the poloidal temperature gradient of neutral particles in a specified internal state in diffusive thermal-energy transport. It is internal-state-resolved and represents only the Fickian poloidal contribution.

pairs.description_left: Fick's-law neutral internal-state energy diffusion coefficient multiplying the temperature gradient of neutral particles in one internal state in diffusive thermal-energy transport, serving as the direction-agnostic parent over its radial and poloidal component forms.
pairs.description_right: Fick's-law radial neutral internal-state energy diffusion coefficient multiplying the R-direction temperature gradient, in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame, of neutral particles in a specified internal state in diffusive thermal-energy transport. It is internal-state-resolved and represents only the Fickian radial contribution.

pairs.description_left: Fick's-law poloidal neutral internal-state energy diffusion coefficient multiplying the poloidal temperature gradient of neutral particles in a specified internal state in diffusive thermal-energy transport. It is internal-state-resolved and represents only the Fickian poloidal contribution.
pairs.description_right: Fick's-law radial neutral internal-state energy diffusion coefficient multiplying the R-direction temperature gradient, in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame, of neutral particles in a specified internal state in diffusive thermal-energy transport. It is internal-state-resolved and represents only the Fickian radial contribution.

pairs.description_left: Vertical Z-coordinate of the reference point of a lower-hybrid antenna in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.
pairs.description_right: Vertical Z-coordinate of the reference point of a lower-hybrid antenna row in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame, where R is major radius, φ is toroidal angle, and Z is vertical height.

pairs.description_left: Imaginary coefficient of the radial component of a complex perturbed magnetic vector-potential eigenfunction for one toroidal linear-MHD mode in the vacuum region.
pairs.description_right: Imaginary quadrature of the complex toroidal magnetic-vector-potential perturbation eigenfunction for a linear MHD mode in the plasma.

pairs.description_left: Dimensionless toroidal plasma-momentum flux contribution driven by the perturbed parallel electromagnetic vector potential in gyrokinetic turbulence, generalized across parallel and perpendicular velocity-space channels.
pairs.description_right: Gyro-Bohm-normalized perpendicular-velocity component of toroidal momentum flux driven by perturbed parallel magnetic-field fluctuations in gyrokinetic turbulence.

pairs.description_left: Gyro-Bohm-normalized parallel-velocity component of toroidal momentum flux driven by perturbed parallel magnetic-field fluctuations in gyrokinetic turbulence.
pairs.description_right: Normalized toroidal plasma-momentum flux contribution driven by the perturbed parallel electromagnetic vector potential in gyrokinetic turbulence, restricted to the perpendicular velocity-space channel.

pairs.description_left: Dimensionless toroidal plasma-momentum flux contribution driven by the perturbed parallel electromagnetic vector potential in gyrokinetic turbulence, generalized across parallel and perpendicular velocity-space channels.
pairs.description_right: Gyro-Bohm-normalized parallel-velocity component of toroidal momentum flux driven by perturbed parallel magnetic-field fluctuations in gyrokinetic turbulence.

pairs.description_left: Number density of fast electrons representing the suprathermal population distinct from the bulk thermal electron population.
pairs.description_right: Number density of free electrons per physical volume for the complete local population, combining thermal and fast electrons rather than selecting one population component.

pairs.description_left: Number density of fast electrons representing the suprathermal population distinct from the bulk thermal electron population.
pairs.description_right: Number density of free electrons per physical volume for the local thermal electron population, excluding fast and suprathermal electron contributions.

pairs.description_left: Number density of free electrons per physical volume for the local thermal electron population, excluding fast and suprathermal electron contributions.
pairs.description_right: Number density of free electrons per physical volume for the complete local population, combining thermal and fast electrons rather than selecting one population component.
